research_basis: Sarkka, Bayesian Filtering and Smoothing (2013), ch. 8
note: Smoothing happens in pixel coordinates (u, v) because the ball's image is near-constant-velocity during flight, while its ground projection bunches at the arc apex. The per-frame H is applied to the smoothed pixel position to produce xy_m. xy_m is therefore still the ground projection of a possibly-airborne ball — it sits past the true bounce point during flight — but the trail now progresses smoothly across the court.
